column3: Saori Route ・ Meeting With Her
...Alright.
After firmly tying my shoes, I pick up the otaku goods I had placed next to me.
Of course, they are the otaku goods Saori gave me.
Well then, time to go.
It's been one week since I had last seen Saori.
This past week, I still have not heard from her.
She has been ignoring my calls and texts.
This has had as strong an effect on my delicate, puberty-riddled heart as when Ayase blocked my number.
...Thank you so much. With this, my mind is set.
Since then, I always wondered about what she set her mind on.
It's about time I found out.
Okay, I'm off.
Kyousuke-shi!
Wooooaaaah!?
Wait, Saori? Why are you here...
Or rather, I was just going to see you, but...
I am truly sorry for coming here so suddenly.
I came here to draw the line... I have come to bid farewell.
Farewell...?
You're joking right? Suddenly saying you're going away, this doesn't make any sense.
I am serious. Dead serious.
I can't approve of this seriousness.
I thought you would say something like that.
I will properly explain the circumstances.
Could you and Kiririn-shi spare me a little time?
Huh? What's that all about?
Marriage interview? Fiancé? I haven't heard a word of this!
And what's up with that guy? Not permitting swirly glasses to be an otaku, saying "I will mend your body"?
He's just a lolicon... Who does he think he is!
Just this time, I completely agreed with everything Kirino said.
Kiririn-shi, please calm down.
How could I calm down!
Rather, why are you so calm?! This is your problem!
...My mind is already set.
Saori...
...Hey Saori.
I asked this earlier but, what have you set your mind on?"
...It's just as it means.
He is stuck thinking that you, Kiririn-shi, and Kuroneko-shi are "Bad friends who tricked me into the path of otaku. "
It's okay if it's just me, but I can't let him have such a misunderstanding of my precious friends.
Then, why...
That man has a very influential voice. Facing the recent problems caused by 2D on society, he's been actively pushing restrictions on 2D.
Of course, he alone is not the problem. However, it can't escape the attention of society.
...I became the spark for the situation, and I couldn't stand seeing my favorite anime and games getting blamed.
They are important things as they bring everyone together...
Saori...
I do not want to cause trouble for everyone.
That's why I will end my relationship with everyone to prevent causing more trouble.
What's up with that...
If our friendship is as precious as you say, you will end that friendship to help us?
That is a horrible way to evaluate the situation. Don't you understand what you are saying?
Of course. I decided after thinking it over.
If I wasn't here, things would be peacefully settled. I am the root of all the trouble.
...Seriously, this conversation is annoying.
Kirino? What are you sayi-
But it's true, right?
You hid the fact you had a marriage interview, let the conversation expand, and got 2D regulated?
Honestly, it's extremely annoying.
...My sincerest apologies.
Oh, you think apologizing will be the end of it?
Hey, hey, hey, hey!
Kirino, you are going way too far.
Kirino!
